summary: Defines the SIP History-Info header field, which records how and why a request reached a given application or user. This supports services such as voicemail and call distribution. It also defines related header parameters and a Privacy value to anonymize the information.

eli5.summary: Like a package with stickers listing every place it was forwarded, so the final person knows how it got there.

questions: how to know why a sip call was redirected
